title: AgentFileOps SSH Transport Configuration
description: Canonical SSH/SFTP transport policy for AgentFileOps. Secret material is referenced, never embedded in protocol operations.

known_hosts_ref.description: Reference or mounted path to trusted known_hosts material. Unknown and mismatched keys fail closed.

credential_ref.description: Reference to an SSH agent or mounted secret-backed credential source. Raw credentials are not allowed.

inline_read_bytes.description: Maximum bytes returned by bounded inline reads before the operation fails with a read-limit error.
